column1: # Test-pattern colour round trip: each SMPTE bar's median colour.
# Measured from the sender's encoded track read at the local relay with tatolab-read-track and decoded by ffmpeg to RGB PNGs.

# White reads 0.9216 and black 0.0627 because the encoder writes TV-range samples (Y 16-235) while its VUI signals full range and names no matrix, which ffmpeg honours; correcting either moves this baseline.
# Default verification tolerance is ±0.05 absolute on the [0,1] scale, per bar and channel.
